title: Elemental Analysis of Inhalable Particles by SEM-EDS
content: The study of individual atmospheric particles is of growing interest in order to understand their action on the environment and because of the uncertainty that exists regarding their effects on human health; because their identification will allow easier action to be taken to control them and to locate the sources of emissions, as well as the processes that originate them; mainly those that are widely distributed in space and time, such as those of an industry, an arid zone, and geological resources in particular (deserts, volcanoes); because they are necessary to carry out the specific assembly of each particle, since the chemical composition of atmospheric aerosols varies according to the size of the particle, the geographic location and the season of the year.
